title: group_invite — output
description: Output schema for the SOX group_invite operation. Confirms the invitation was recorded. Normative reference: spec/primitives/groups.md §5.2.

invited.description: True when the invite was successfully recorded. False if the agent was already an active member (idempotent path).

agent_id.description: The agent_id that was invited, echoed from the input.

invited_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the invitation was recorded.
